supersedes: PREREGISTRATION_V3_2.json after the OrbitTrace rank/recovery gate failed

changes.refinement_generation: Local refinements use the recurrent EOM plus ordinary leaf memberships from each fixed window, rather than year-blind EOM alone.
changes.refinement_ranking: Number of independently supporting overlapping windows, then recurrent seed score, then fixed-membership calibration statistics.
changes.membership_null: Seven deterministic solar-pair cyclic permutations per held-out year replace the degenerate empirical-rank background p-values. BH q<=0.10 is applied before D<=0.15.

unchanged.target_firewall: target membership unavailable through final ranking and membership materialization

scientific_disclosure: The cross-window priority was introduced after the frozen v3.2 catalogue revealed that the target-bearing seed was supported in two windows but ranked 905. OrbitTrace evidence is target-exposed recovery evidence, not prospective discovery.
stopping_rule: Any further semantic change creates v3.4 and restarts the gate order.
